name: znetwork_get_local_player_color_index
description: zNetwork::GetLocalPlayerColorIndex returns the cached local player color index, or zero when no local player record exists.
known_limits: No isolated VC COFF byte comparison is recorded for this getter; tier S verification is deferred to a coherent zNetwork source-cluster pass.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x48b980 validates a null check of g_zNetwork_LocalPlayerRecord and a return of colorIndex from offset 0xe0.
The native zNetwork identity smoke verifies the null-record zero return and the cached local-player color-index return.
